summary: scripts/st-test-test's git repositories turn off gc.auto and maintenance.auto. After a fetch, git started a detached `git maintenance run --auto`, whose `git repack -d` was still writing objects/pack/tmp_rev_* while the test removed its temporary directory, so PerCrate tests failed with "Directory not empty" (8 of 48 runs at eight-way on a build host; 0 of 48 after). st-test-test runs in the required ci-script-tests check.

replay.detail: Test-only change; no claim, replay or projection change.

rules.detail: No rule, permission or trust change.

compatibility.detail: No wire, CLI or client change.

downtime.detail: Nothing runs differently on installed machines.

recovery.detail: Revert the commit to let git's automatic maintenance run in the test repositories again.
